import ast, json, pathlib, tomllib
root = pathlib.Path('.')
files = sorted(root.rglob('*.py'))
for path in files:
    ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), filename=path.as_posix())
project = tomllib.loads((root / 'pyproject.toml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
entrypoint = project['project']['scripts']['mcp-pinot']
module_name, function_name = entrypoint.split(':', 1)
module_path = root / (module_name.replace('.', '/') + '.py')
tree = ast.parse(module_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), filename=module_path.as_posix())
functions = {node.name for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
assert function_name in functions
print(json.dumps({'declared_entrypoint': entrypoint, 'entrypoint_function_found': True, 'python_files_parsed': len(files)}, sort_keys=True))
